mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Shading, shadowing.
m. (-रः)
1 A catta or umbrella bearer.
2 A species of metre.
E.
छाया shade, and कर who makes.

m. (-यः)
A name of SATURN.
E.
छाया the wife of SŪRYA, and तनय a son; also similar compounds, as छायात्मज, छायासुत, &c.

m. (-रुः)
A large tree, one that gives shade or shelter.
E.
छाया, and तरु a tree.

m. (-थः)
Æther, the Ākāśa or firmament.
E.
छाया light, and पथ a road.

m. (-भृत्)
CANDRA or the moon.
E.
छाया light, and भृत् who possesses.

Casting a shadow.
E.
छाया, and मयट् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A catta or parasol.
E.
छाया shade, and मित्र friendly.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
छाया an image, मृग a deer, and धर who possesses; also छायाधर, and मृगधर severally.
